root_cause_repaired: PresentationTracker used stale 1x1 metrics after the real HWND was bound, rejecting canonical presentation as kMetricsMismatch and accumulating pending handoffs.
Fallback cleanup did not notify the Windows primary backend, and empty Arc layers could retain compositor pixels.
Windows release path now hides the transient layer without moving or destroying the host window.
